items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: And then that was back, back on Clara. Clara, near, can't do it.

ctx.x: When you were saying that he had everybody in the church crying, did he play it inside the church?

No, coming up, you see, when they come back, when the boy was telling me to tell us to play. And then he started on this thing, he said, you mean John, John, John, for it? Yeah, go in, go in, go in, go in. Go to that bathroom, sir. And that man, he didn't want to cry. And I was like, I didn't know John. And then that was back, back on Clara. Clara, near, can't do it. Yeah, you know, so my back, they had the church so my back. But now, if things messes back down, if I go back down, I wouldn't know myself. But at…
Better than a tenor saxophone. Yeah, sure. Sure. Did they have any outstanding alto, those horn men?
